meta.source: Evidence UI tokens. Neutral values documented in NOTICE.md.

tokens.name: ev-background-100
tokens.usage: Page canvas. The report is normally one continuous canvas on this color.

tokens.name: ev-background-200
tokens.usage: Secondary surface: bar tracks, disabled fields. Never a card fill for ordinary sections.

tokens.name: ev-gray-100
tokens.usage: Lowest gray step. Rarely used directly; prefer alpha grays over surfaces.

tokens.name: ev-gray-200
tokens.usage: Subtle fills.

tokens.name: ev-gray-300
tokens.usage: Subtle fills, hover backgrounds.

tokens.name: ev-gray-400
tokens.usage: Default fills.

tokens.name: ev-gray-500
tokens.usage: Decorative rules only; too light for text.

tokens.name: ev-gray-600
tokens.usage: Disabled marks; too light for body text.

tokens.name: ev-gray-700
tokens.usage: Placeholder-level marks. Below 4.5:1 on canvas, so never body text.

tokens.name: ev-gray-800
tokens.usage: Tertiary chart series (chart-3/6). Use only at 18px+ or for marks.

tokens.name: ev-gray-900
tokens.usage: Secondary text on background-100 and background-200 (text-secondary). Chart series 2.

tokens.name: ev-gray-1000
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, primary button fill, chart series 1.

tokens.name: ev-gray-alpha-100
tokens.usage: Hairline tint.

tokens.name: ev-gray-alpha-200
tokens.usage: Button hover fill.

tokens.name: ev-gray-alpha-300
tokens.usage: Subtle borders (border-subtle).

tokens.name: ev-gray-alpha-400
tokens.usage: Default borders for controls and table rules (border-default).

tokens.name: ev-gray-alpha-500
tokens.usage: Stronger tint.

tokens.name: ev-gray-alpha-600
tokens.usage: Stronger tint.

tokens.name: ev-gray-alpha-700
tokens.usage: Strong borders, hovered inputs (border-strong).

tokens.name: ev-gray-alpha-800
tokens.usage: Overlay tint.

tokens.name: ev-gray-alpha-900
tokens.usage: Overlay tint.

tokens.name: ev-gray-alpha-1000
tokens.usage: Near-opaque overlay.

tokens.name: ev-blue-100
tokens.usage: Blue scale. Tinted background for a state that needs a surface. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

tokens.name: ev-blue-400

tokens.name: ev-blue-700
tokens.usage: Blue scale. Solid state fill. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

tokens.name: ev-blue-900
tokens.usage: Blue scale. State text and marks on canvas. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

tokens.name: ev-blue-1000
tokens.usage: Blue scale. Highest-contrast state text. Color only when it adds meaning to state, action or data, paired with a non-color cue.

tokens.name: ev-surface-primary
tokens.usage: Default page surface.

tokens.name: ev-surface-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary surface for bar tracks and disabled states.

tokens.name: ev-surface-contrast
tokens.usage: The only contrast field: Band with inverse. Same in both themes. Use the Band component instead of painting this surface yourself.

tokens.name: ev-text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings, values on surface-primary and surface-secondary.

tokens.name: ev-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, metadata, helper text on surface-primary and surface-secondary. Never tiny gray prose.

tokens.name: ev-text-on-contrast
tokens.usage: Text on surface-contrast.

tokens.name: ev-text-on-contrast-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-contrast.

tokens.name: ev-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Table row rules and quiet separators. Prefer spacing first.

tokens.name: ev-border-default
tokens.usage: Control borders (buttons, inputs).

tokens.name: ev-border-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered input border, table header rule.

tokens.name: ev-border-on-contrast
tokens.usage: Borders inside a contrast band.

tokens.name: ev-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: ev-color-info
tokens.usage: Informational state. Pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: ev-color-success
tokens.usage: Success state. Never to make a favorable number green.

tokens.name: ev-color-warning
tokens.usage: Warning state. Pair with a word.

tokens.name: ev-color-error
tokens.usage: Error text and invalid field borders.

tokens.name: ev-chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1: the decisive series.

tokens.name: ev-chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2: supporting or reference series.

tokens.name: ev-chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3.

tokens.name: ev-chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (repeats 1; distinguish with dash or direct label).

tokens.name: ev-chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (repeats 2; distinguish with dash or direct label).

tokens.name: ev-chart-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6 (repeats 3; distinguish with dash or direct label).

styles.name: ev-t-display
styles.sample: Checkout loads in under a second
styles.usage: Only the single page-defining statement, when scale is earned. Max 20ch.

styles.name: ev-t-title
styles.sample: An annual plan saves $86,400 at today’s usage
styles.usage: The normal page title (h1). Says what happened or what decision is needed. Max 24ch.

styles.name: ev-t-h24
styles.sample: Most of the saving comes from compute
styles.usage: Major section turns (h2). Sentence case, states the claim.

styles.name: ev-t-lede
styles.sample: The median checkout page loaded in 0.84 s in September, down from 2.1 s in June.
styles.usage: One short orientation passage under the title, in text-secondary. Max 68ch.

styles.name: ev-t-body
styles.sample: Load times come from real-user monitoring on desktop and mobile. Bot traffic is excluded, and weeks with fewer than 200 sessions are left out.
styles.usage: Reading prose, 60 to 68 characters per line.

styles.name: ev-t-small
styles.usage: Captions, stat labels, button text (at weight 500), tables in compact density.

styles.name: ev-t-label
styles.usage: Field labels and helper text, in text-secondary.

styles.name: ev-t-meta
styles.usage: Masthead metadata and footer line. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: ev-value-lead
styles.usage: A decisive stat or calculator result. Tabular numerals. Peers share this exact role.

styles.name: ev-t-code
styles.usage: Only code, commands, paths, raw tokens, timestamps and short IDs. Set only the identifier in mono, never the whole sentence or table.

spacing.note: Within-group gaps are space-2 to space-4; between groups space-6 to space-8; section turns space-8 to space-12.

tokens.name: ev-space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps inside a control.

tokens.name: ev-space-2
tokens.usage: Tight within-group gap: label to value.

tokens.name: ev-space-3
tokens.usage: Within-group gap.

tokens.name: ev-space-4
tokens.usage: Paragraph to paragraph; copy flow.

tokens.name: ev-space-5
tokens.usage: Within-group gap, roomy.

tokens.name: ev-space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups (low end); grid column gutter.

tokens.name: ev-space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups; peer stat gap.

tokens.name: ev-space-10
tokens.usage: Between groups (high end).

tokens.name: ev-space-12
tokens.usage: Major section turn.

tokens.name: ev-space-16
tokens.usage: True chapter break only. Never the default page-stack gap.

tokens.name: ev-radius-small
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, small controls.

tokens.name: ev-radius
tokens.usage: The few surfaces that earn one: a contained calculator, a contrast band.

tokens.name: ev-control-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: ev-control-height-touch
tokens.usage: Control height on touch layouts.

tokens.name: ev-content-width
tokens.usage: Max width of the report shell.

tokens.name: ev-chart-min-width
tokens.usage: A chart narrower than this scrolls inside its viewport.

tokens.name: ev-weight-regular
tokens.usage: Body copy.

tokens.name: ev-weight-heading
tokens.usage: All headings and primary values.

tokens.name: ev-weight-medium
tokens.usage: Buttons, strong emphasis, error text.

tokens.name: ev-weight-semibold
tokens.usage: Rare. Never for ordinary headings.
